## 1. Data Import & Preprocessing (NCBI GEO Microarray: GSE51808)

We analyze human whole-blood microarray gene expression data from NCBI GEO (**GSE51808**) to compare uncomplicated **Dengue Fever (DF)** and severe **Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF)**.

```{r load-packages}
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(hthgu133pluspm.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(caret)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r import-clean}
# Load the Series Matrix file from the local data/ directory
matrix_file <- "../data/GSE51808_series_matrix.txt.gz"
gse <- getGEO(filename = matrix_file, getGPL = FALSE)

expr_raw <- exprs(gse)
meta_raw <- pData(gse)

# Search metadata columns to filter acute DF and DHF patient samples
meta_text <- apply(meta_raw, 1, paste, collapse = " ")
keep_samples <- grepl("\\bDF\\b|\\bDHF\\b|Dengue Fever|Dengue Hemorrhagic", meta_text, ignore.case = TRUE) &
                !grepl("Convalescent|Healthy|Control", meta_text, ignore.case = TRUE)

expr_clean <- expr_raw[, keep_samples]
meta_clean <- meta_raw[keep_samples, ]
meta_text_clean <- meta_text[keep_samples]

# Create binary clinical class labels: DF vs DHF
meta_clean$Condition <- ifelse(grepl("\\bDHF\\b|Hemorrhagic", meta_text_clean, ignore.case = TRUE), "DHF", "DF")
meta_clean$Condition <- factor(meta_clean$Condition, levels = c("DF", "DHF"))

print(table(meta_clean$Condition))
```

## 2. Quality Control & Microarray Intensity Distribution

```{r qc-check}
# Remove missing values (NA)
expr_clean <- na.omit(expr_clean)

# Verify log2-normalized microarray intensity range
print(summary(as.vector(expr_clean)))

# Save cleaned sample metadata
write.csv(meta_clean[, c("geo_accession", "title", "Condition")], "../data/sample_metadata.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Boxplot of sample expression distributions
expr_long <- as.data.frame(expr_clean) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  left_join(meta_clean[, c("geo_accession", "Condition")], by = c("Sample" = "geo_accession"))

p_box <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = Sample, y = Expression, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Microarray Quality Control: Log2 Intensity Distribution Across Samples",
       x = "Patient Samples", y = "Log2 Normalized Intensity")

print(p_box)
ggsave("../figures/01_qc_boxplot.png", p_box, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 3. Exploratory Data Analysis: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r eda-pca}
# Unsupervised dimensionality reduction using PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(t(expr_clean), scale. = TRUE)
var_explained <- round(100 * (pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)), 1)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  Condition = meta_clean$Condition
)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition, shape = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DF" = "#1b9e77", "DHF" = "#d95f02")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of Whole-Blood Microarray Profiles (DF vs. DHF)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% Variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% Variance)"))

print(p_pca)
ggsave("../figures/02_pca_plot.png", p_pca, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 4. Differential Gene Expression Analysis (`limma`)

```{r limma-deg}
# Linear modeling and empirical Bayes moderation for microarray differential expression
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + meta_clean$Condition)
colnames(design) <- c("DF", "DHF")

fit <- lmFit(expr_clean, design)
contrast_mat <- makeContrasts(DHF_vs_DF = DHF - DF, levels = design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_mat))

# Extract ranked gene list with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR multiple-testing correction
deg_table <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DHF_vs_DF", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
deg_table$ProbeID <- rownames(deg_table)

# Annotate microarray Probe IDs with official Human Gene Symbols
deg_table$GeneSymbol <- mapIds(hthgu133pluspm.db,
                               keys = deg_table$ProbeID,
                               column = "SYMBOL",
                               keytype = "PROBEID",
                               multiVals = "first")

# Classify significant biomarkers (FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1)
deg_table$Status <- "Not Significant"
deg_table$Status[deg_table$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_table$logFC > 1]  <- "Upregulated in DHF"
deg_table$Status[deg_table$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & deg_table$logFC < -1] <- "Downregulated in DHF"

print(table(deg_table$Status))
write.csv(deg_table, "../data/deg_results_full.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Table of Top 10 Differentially Expressed Genes
top10_table <- deg_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol) & GeneSymbol != "") %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  select(ProbeID, GeneSymbol, logFC, AveExpr, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Status) %>%
  head(10)

knitr::kable(top10_table, digits = 4, caption = "Top 10 Differentially Expressed Genes (DHF vs. DF)")
```

### 4.1 Volcano Plot & Hierarchical Clustering Heatmap

```{r deg-plots}
# Volcano Plot
p_volcano <- ggplot(deg_table, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = Status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Downregulated in DHF" = "#2b8cbe",
                                "Not Significant" = "grey70",
                                "Upregulated in DHF" = "#e34a33")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Differential Gene Expression (DHF vs. DF)",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change (DHF / DF)",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-Value (FDR)")

print(p_volcano)
ggsave("../figures/03_volcano_plot.png", p_volcano, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Unsupervised Hierarchical Clustering of Top 35 Biomarker Genes
top35_probes <- head(deg_table$ProbeID[order(deg_table$adj.P.Val)], 35)
top35_labels <- deg_table$GeneSymbol[match(top35_probes, deg_table$ProbeID)]
top35_labels <- ifelse(is.na(top35_labels) | top35_labels == "", top35_probes, top35_labels)

heatmap_mat <- expr_clean[top35_probes, ]
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- make.unique(top35_labels)

col_annot <- data.frame(Condition = meta_clean$Condition)
rownames(col_annot) <- colnames(heatmap_mat)

pheatmap(heatmap_mat, scale = "row", annotation_col = col_annot,
         show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7,
         main = "Hierarchical Clustering of Top 35 Differentially Expressed Genes")

png("../figures/04_top35_heatmap.png", width = 2400, height = 2100, res = 300)
pheatmap(heatmap_mat, scale = "row", annotation_col = col_annot,
         show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize_row = 7,
         main = "Hierarchical Clustering of Top 35 Differentially Expressed Genes")
dev.off()
```

## 5. Supervised Classification: Support Vector Machine (`caret` + `e1071`)

Using the top 15 differentially expressed genes as features, we train a **Support Vector Machine (SVM)** classifier with 5-fold cross-validation to classify patients into **DF** or **DHF**.

```{r svm-classifier}
top15_probes <- head(deg_table$ProbeID[order(deg_table$adj.P.Val)], 15)
ml_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_clean[top15_probes, ]))
colnames(ml_df) <- make.names(colnames(ml_df))
ml_df$Condition <- meta_clean$Condition

set.seed(42)
cv_ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                        number = 5,
                        repeats = 5,
                        classProbs = TRUE,
                        summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                        savePredictions = "final")

svm_fit <- train(Condition ~ .,
                 data = ml_df,
                 method = "svmRadial",
                 metric = "ROC",
                 preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                 trControl = cv_ctrl)

print(svm_fit)

# Evaluate Classification Performance with Confusion Matrix & ROC Curve
cm <- confusionMatrix(svm_fit$pred$pred, svm_fit$pred$obs, positive = "DHF")
print(cm$table)
print(cm$overall["Accuracy"])

roc_res <- roc(svm_fit$pred$obs, svm_fit$pred$DHF, quiet = TRUE)
auc_val <- round(auc(roc_res), 3)
print(paste("Cross-Validated SVM ROC-AUC:", auc_val))

plot(roc_res, col = "#d95f02", lwd = 3,
     main = paste0("5-Fold CV ROC Curve: SVM Classifier (AUC = ", auc_val, ")"))

png("../figures/05_svm_roc_curve.png", width = 1800, height = 1600, res = 300)
plot(roc_res, col = "#d95f02", lwd = 3,
     main = paste0("5-Fold CV ROC Curve: SVM Classifier (AUC = ", auc_val, ")"))
dev.off()
```
